svg.text: 10 directions · greyscale first · every card tested at 64 / 32 / 16 px
Break out of the loop: the 45° climb exits
Four pilot rank stripes swept into a wing —
A C wraps a P; the P bowl kisses the C at
The runway from application to offer,
The readiness dial, needle pinned straight
The offer checkmark whose long arm keeps
The aviator swift — goggle band, eyes
Your current paper-plane glyph, rebuilt on
Two solid chevrons; the implied third
